scope: Local reproductions supporting floor decisions; not full matrix or broker compatibility evidence

environment.isolation: Fresh venv, no editable project or development dependencies

cases.test: Two minimal tests: one fixture-backed def test and one pytest.mark.asyncio test; run with --alluredir

initial_result.safe_failure: allure_pytest.listener._test_fixtures passes item.nodeid to getfixturedefs: AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'iter_parents'

cases.decision: Raise the global Allure floor to 2.13.5; retain the original failing result separately from the passing replacement.

initial_result.safe_failure: confluent-kafka==2.6.0 has no usable wheels; requirements unsatisfiable under binary-only installation

cases.decision: Retain >=2.6 for Python <3.14; use >=2.12.1 for Python >=3.14. The CI binary-wheel policy avoids undeclared librdkafka/toolchain prerequisites; this does not claim every source build of 2.6.0 is impossible.

initial_result.safe_failure: Retained raw-session async iterators reached loop shutdown without explicit aclose; async-generator finalization emitted unawaited aclose and pending-task diagnostics.

diagnostic_replacement.note: Upstream 0.25.2 adds loop.shutdown_asyncgens, but this diagnostic replacement is not the selected minimum.

selected_fix.change: The three direct-session test cases explicitly close their caller-owned receive iterator with contextlib.aclosing. Runtime code and dependency floor are unchanged.
selected_fix.remaining_diagnostics: Upstream event-loop policy DeprecationWarnings on Python 3.14

cases.decision: Retain the exact pytest-asyncio 0.25.0 floor; correct test resource ownership instead of hiding it behind a dependency upgrade.

retained_yanked_floor_pins.reason: fatal regression when combined with pytest-cov

yanked_pin_policy: These explicit compatibility test pins exercise the actual declared floors; they are not recommended deployment versions. The full preliminary minimum suite, generated-Protobuf checks, and a two-worker pytest-cov/Allure smoke passed locally. No floor is silently raised based solely on a yank warning; preserve the upstream status and test the selected profiles.
